digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output parser (llm/structured.py) and completion verification gate
propositions: The completion verifier returns a Dep record instead of CompletionVerdict because tolerant_parse selects the first JSON object that parses, not the first that satisfies the target schema.

When the verifier quotes a ticket's dependency link record in prose before the verdict, that record wins the schema-blind extraction and fails validation, while a valid CompletionVerdict sits later in the reply.

The schema-blind selection policy is deliberate and shared across all structured LLM gates (plan-review, code-review, overlap, ticket-digest), making it unsafe to fix at the extraction layer alone without atomic directive + extraction changes.
Five prior recurrences of the same selection defect across the codebase indicate the architecture—positional heuristics on an untyped channel—not individual instances, is at fault.

A permanent fix requires four layers: provider-native output where measured (Layer 1, experiments E1 proved feasibility), prompted-path hardening with sentinel channel and schema-filtered last-valid selection (Layer 2), invariant-level tests (Layer 3), and reply artifact capture on failure (Layer 4).
